name: Bash Scripts Post-Git-Bash-3.6.7 Compatibility
description: Triggered by 1.1.0_SA_CTO 20260429T125328Z empirical observation that org/mcp/inbox-watch.sh single-watcher guard silently fell through (3 concurrent watchers running for 1.1.0_SA_CTO). Root cause: Git Bash for Windows updated to 3.6.7-fb42d713 on 2026-03-29 dropped pgrep/pkill/flock/pidof/setsid/wget from the default install. CTO Phase 1 audit (2026-04-29) found that of 43 local-runtime bash scripts under .tools/, org/mcp/, org/threads/, infra/aws/lambda/ci/, infra/aws/terraform/, all 43 pass bash -n syntax check under bash 5.3.9 and exactly ONE uses a now-missing utility: org/mcp/inbox-watch.sh (pgrep). EC2-side scripts that use pgrep/pkill run on Amazon Linux where the utilities are present and are out of scope. Project scope: ship the 1.1.0_SA_CTO drafted ps+awk fallback patch + add a CLAUDE.md authoring rule for local-runtime bash scripts + document the utility availability table in workspace memory. Original concern that 'many bash scripts may not be functional' was empirically rejected by the audit.
phase: COMPLETE 2026-04-29 — .001 ca6946e5f (1.0.0_SA_CTO: CLAUDE.md Rule 16 + memory companion + PRD Phase 1 flip); .002 045296b18 (0.7.0_AE_CloudOps: inbox-watch.sh pgrep+ps awk fallback, functional test PASS, orphan broadcast sent to all 8 live agents). .003 STAGED-LOW indefinitely (pre-commit hook, deferred unless 2nd incident surfaces).
blocking: None. Project complete. .003 STAGED-LOW — activate only if a second local-runtime missing-utility incident surfaces.
